Probable fix (inferred from the hint only — unverified, since I never saw the source)
- "wordCount counts surrounding whitespace as extra words" means the implementation almost certainly counts empty tokens produced by leading/trailing (or repeated) whitespace, e.g. `text.split(' ').length` or `text.split(/\s/).length`, so "  hello world  " → 4 instead of 2. The fix is to tokenize on runs of whitespace and drop empties, e.g.:
    const wordCount = (text: string): number =>
      text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  which also returns 0 for an empty/whitespace-only string. Apply that to the real wordCount implementation once the directory is readable.
